title: ДЕТИ (Children)
music: Mournful cinematic orchestral score for a true war documentary: solo cello, low sustained strings, sparse piano, a slow build to a heavy, grieving swell, then quiet strings and a single piano line at the end. No drums, no vocals.
ambience: Cold winter wind in an empty city, faint distant rumble, no music.
disclosure: Illustrations and motion generated with AI from the accounts of survivors and witnesses; they are not photographs. All names have been changed. Witness lines are quoted from Amnesty International's report and voiced by synthetic voices.

sources.name: Amnesty International, “Children”: The Attack on the Donetsk Regional Academic Drama Theatre in Mariupol, Ukraine (June 2022)
Death toll estimates: Mariupol City Council; Associated Press investigation (2022)

shots.say: Mariupol, Ukraine. March, twenty twenty-two. The city is under siege.

ov.text: The events in this film are real.|They were documented by Amnesty International from the accounts of survivors and witnesses.|Some of them may still live under occupation. For their safety, every name has been changed.|No faces are shown.

sfx.prompt: Cold winter wind through an empty city street, distant muffled rumble far away, no music

shots.say: In the centre of the city stands the Drama Theatre. Its stage has gone dark. Its basement is full.

sfx.prompt: Footsteps on snow, a heavy wooden door, muffled voices in a stone basement

shots.say: Hundreds of people shelter here. It is where food, water and medicine are handed out, and where families wait for a way out of the city.

sfx.prompt: Outdoor field kitchen in winter: a wood fire crackling, a metal pot lid, quiet murmuring

shots.say: Outside, someone paints one word on the ground, in letters big enough to read from the sky.

sfx.prompt: A single deep low string note swelling slowly, cold wind

shots.say: On the fourteenth and fifteenth of March, many people manage to leave. Most of those who stay sleep in the basement: the safest place they know.

sfx.prompt: Several cars driving slowly away on a snowy road, engines fading
A child's crayon scratching on paper in a quiet room

shots.say: Sixteenth of March. Just after ten in the morning.

sfx.prompt: A quiet empty hall in the morning, a faraway clock ticking

shots.say: Pavlo, an architect, is two or three hundred metres away. He hears a plane. Then bombs. He watches the roof lift.

lines.text: It all happened in front of our eyes.

sfx.prompt: A jet aircraft passing high overhead through clouds, rising roar
A huge distant double explosion, deep and muffled, then falling debris and silence

shots.say: A man walking toward the building sees it too.

lines.text: I couldn't believe my eyes, because the theatre was a sanctuary.

sfx.prompt: High ringing in the ears after an explosion, muffled distant shouting

shots.say: In the basement, Daryna is with her mother and her boyfriend. Dust fills everything. People are screaming. They grab their documents and run.

sfx.prompt: Muffled panicked voices in a dusty basement, coughing, footsteps rushing, debris settling

shots.say: Andriy searches for his father. He finds him in the concert hall, under the bricks. All he can think is: my mother must not see this.

sfx.prompt: A ruined hall: dust falling, a brick shifting, distant sirens, then quiet

shots.say: A woman we will call Nadiya crawls out of the rubble. She asks the people around her for one thing: to remember her name. She dies soon after.

sfx.prompt: A slow breath, wind through a broken building, a long quiet

shots.say: Amnesty International spoke to fifty-two survivors and witnesses. It found that two five-hundred-kilogram bombs struck almost at once, most likely dropped by a Russian fighter jet.

sfx.prompt: A quiet office: computer fans, pages turning, a pen on paper

shots.say: No witness reported any military use of the theatre. It was clearly a civilian building, and the word on the ground could be read from the air. Amnesty called the attack a clear war crime.

sfx.prompt: Cold wind over ruins, a loose sheet of metal creaking

shots.say: How many people died is still disputed. Amnesty counted at least a dozen, and probably more. The city council said about three hundred. An Associated Press investigation estimated close to six hundred.

sfx.prompt: Candles flickering in the cold, soft wind, very quiet

shots.say: International humanitarian law forbids attacks on civilians and on civilian buildings. It was written for days exactly like this one.

sfx.prompt: A deep hush, a single sustained low note

shots.say: Someone wrote 'children' on the ground, so it could be read from the sky. And a woman, in her last moments, asked only to be remembered. We changed her name to protect the people who survived. Her real name is in the record. Remember her.

sfx.prompt: Early morning in an empty snowy city, distant birds, wind dying down
